changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate task entry and simplified dataset names. Removed redundant output descriptions and consolidated into two clear output types. Normalized model name for consistency.

Normalized metrics to base forms (BLEU instead of BLEU-4, ROUGE instead of ROUGE-L) according to guidelines. Added Tree Edit Distance as it was mentioned but missing from original extraction. Capitalized Tree Edit Distance consistently.
Cleaned up empty fields by removing placeholder 'None' values. No LLMs were used as judges in this paper.

guideline: Human coders labeled explanations based on plausibility (coherence with problem text)

Annotators labeled each generated explanation for (1) plausibility (coherence with the problem) and (2) faithfulness (whether the same equation can be derived from the explanation)

Use at least one word appearing in the problem text when writing an explanation. Do not use the same explanation for different objects. You should be able to formulate equations for solving the problem, using your explanations only.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated and reorganized guideline descriptions to be more comprehensive yet concise. Maintained the two main criteria (plausibility, faithfulness) without modification.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on NLG for explanation generation in algebraic word problem solving. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric names and consolidation of redundant entries. The paper conducts both automatic and human evaluations but does not use LLMs as judges.
